notes: M.G.L. c. 186 § 31 governs the form that must accompany a notice to quit for nonpayment of rent (rental assistance information, a statement that the notice is not an eviction, and court filing proof). It regulates how a tenancy is ended (notice-to-quit contents and attachments), not whether a landlord may end it, so it is out of scope under the just_cause_eviction category rules. No in-scope rule was extracted.
